exposure: COVID-19 vaccination history (first, second, third dose, complete/incomplete vaccination)
cohort: The study included 2396 pregnant and postnatal women who were booked for delivery at Queen Mary Hospital in Hong Kong and attended an antenatal booking visit between July 1, 2021, and June 30, 2022.
finding: The study found that acceptance of COVID-19 vaccination was low in pregnant women, and the COVID-19 disease rate was significantly higher (more than tenfold) in women with no or incomplete vaccination compared to those with complete vaccination.
